properties.displayName: UAV S3 - Unauthorized Weapon Command (ARM/FIRE 2-person control bypass)
properties.description: 무장(Arm)/발사(Fire) 명령의 2인통제 우회 탐지. ArmedBy == Operator(자기승인) 또는 Watchlist에 없는 비인가 Operator/WeaponId로 ARM/FIRE 발생 시 탐지. 실제 컬럼: ArmedBy, Operator (armed_by/fire_requester 없음). MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0831·T0806 / EMB3D 통제신호조작
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedArm = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Arm_Operator_List') | project OperatorId;
let ApprovedWeapons = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Weapon_List') | project WeaponId;
UAVWeapon_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType in ('arm', 'fire')
| extend isSelfApproval = (ArmedBy == Operator)
| extend isUnknownOp = Operator !in (ApprovedArm)
| extend isUnknownWeapon = WeaponId !in (ApprovedWeapons)
| where isSelfApproval or isUnknownOp or isUnknownWeapon
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isSelfApproval, strcat('무장_2인통제_자기승인_', Operator),
    isUnknownOp, strcat('무장_비인가_Operator_', Operator),
    strcat('무장_비인가_WeaponId_', WeaponId))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, Operator, WeaponId, ArmedBy, TargetId, EventType, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S3 - Unauthorized Weapon Command (ARM/FIRE 2-person control bypass) - {{Operator}}
